headline: Flagler put the top of the table beyond reach
dek: North Georgia have played out their conference schedule, and no side left can reach Flagler's points total, so Flagler head to Lander today already sure of finishing top. They have lost once all season, at Florida Southern in September, and no conference side has beaten them.
displaced_by: North Georgia finished their conference schedule below Flagler's points total, so the top of the table is settled; the old dek's 17 conceded is now 18, and its Saturday win is no longer the latest.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Flagler's 36 goals are more than USC Aiken and Georgia Southwestern have scored between them, and twelve different players have shared them.

wire.line: The top of the table is settled: no one left can catch Flagler, who have yet to lose to a conference side.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no published result, every one of them from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Middle Georgia State have conceded 45 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, while scoring 27.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Javier Gongora Andres has scored eleven of Middle Georgia State's 27 goals from 48 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Isaac Calderon has scored nine of North Georgia's 36 goals from 44 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Finn Weigelt has scored ten of Flagler's 36 goals from 34 shots.

last_match.line: North Georgia have beaten Middle Georgia State home and away, and have won every match since losing to Flagler.

next_match.line: Flagler won the September meeting at home; Lander come in off back-to-back conference defeats.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
